action.name: Synapse module discovery
action.value: Module download and post-load idle traffic

validation.applyResult: Not performed; this was an observation capture

sanitizedEvidence.summary: One host-to-pad frame family contained 569 reports with a 59-byte declared payload over 24.925 seconds. The mean interval was 43.882 milliseconds, or 22.789 frames per second.

The observed frame family has a five-byte prefix followed by 18 RGB-sized triplets. This is strong evidence for a host-rendered strip frame, but the field meanings and physical LED geometry remain unconfirmed.
Synapse also exchanged bounded initialization and query candidates before and during the frame stream. Their semantics are not assigned by this capture.

limitations: This multi-device capture selected the Blade and cooling pad on one USB root, but only cooling-pad traffic was observed.
Synapse downloaded the cooling-pad module and requested a reboot before the planned one-action sequence could begin.
The capture does not prove visible effect identity, LED order, interface ownership, persistence, HyperBoost behavior, fan control, keyboard synchronization, or safe operation without the cooling pad.
The five-byte prefix and 18 RGB-sized triplets are structural observations, not a validated geometry or write contract.
notes: The capture ended through the requested stop sentinel with graceful targeted Ctrl+Break.
OpenBlade was running before capture, stopped before USBPcap ownership, and successfully restarted after USBPcap exited.
The raw PCAP, decoded transaction file, state, and operator markers remain local and uncommitted.
